build_ocr_rects: build OCR rectangles for a page by computing optimal bounding boxes based on bitmap coverage
filter_ocr_cells: filter OCR cells by dropping any cells that overlap with existing programmatic text cells
post_process_cells: post-process OCR cells and update the page with combined OCR and programmatic cells
combine_cells: combine existing programmatic cells with OCR cells while filtering overlaps and re-indexing
draw_ocr_rects_and_cells: draw OCR rectangles and cells onto a page image for debugging and visualization
